units.source_text: 千重子不知往哪儿看好，于是她仰望着大枫树的顶梢。

en.t: Chieko did not know where she should look, so she gazed up at the very top of the great maple tree.

units.source_text: 不知是因为月亮出来了，还是闹市区的灯火映照，夜空显得一片白茫茫。

en.t: Whether because the moon had come out, or because the lights of the downtown streets were shining up, the night sky looked hazy and white all over.
